title: Reference table
description: Market, scheme or bank reference data as an effective-dated table (R-01-25, owner's decision of 23 November 2026): a participant directory, the emirates, free zones, purpose codes, business-day calendars, a bank's branches. Values, not logic: a table is looked up by date, never pinned, and travels to the runtime in a bank's configuration release. Its columns are its interface (a change is a new major); a new edition of its rows is a new minor release. It holds no personal data and no bank customer data: those live in the runtime's registers.

domain.description: The name the runtime serves it under: GET /lookups/{domain}.

key.description: The columns that identify a row within an edition.

references.description: Another reference table whose key this column's values are.

maintainedBy.description: Who fills this column when the source does not, for example the platform vendor.

public.description: The source is published reference data, not personal data: it may live in shared scope.
